name: Pillar
overview: Scripture presents pillars as significant physical and symbolic markers in God's dealings with His people. Jacob set up pillars to commemorate divine encounters and covenants, anointing them with oil as a sign of consecration. Moses erected twelve pillars representing the tribes of Israel as a testimony to the covenant with Jehovah. Conversely, pillars associated with idolatry were to be destroyed, emphasizing the exclusive worship of God. Additionally, the transformation of Lot's wife into a pillar of salt serves as a solemn warning against disobedience and looking back in judgment.
